topic.zh: 参数测量 · 低损耗线

statement.zh: 给你一卷长度为 $L=100\mathrm{m}$ 的同轴电缆，要求通过测量确定其性质。测量装置如下图所示。假设可将同轴电缆视为低损耗传输线。
statement.en: You are given a spool of coaxial cable of length $L=100\mathrm{m}$ and are tasked with determining its properties through measurements. A diagram of your measurement setup is shown below. Assume the coaxial cable can be treated as a low-loss transmission line.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 测得电缆的时间延迟为 $T_d=392\mathrm{ns}$。这根同轴电缆的速度因子是多少？
prompt.en: You measure the time delay of your cable to be $T_d=392\mathrm{ns}$. What is the velocity factor of the coaxial cable?

text.zh: 先写传播距离、单程时间与波速的关系，再用速度因子的定义。
text.en: Begin with the distance, one-way time and speed relation, then the velocity-factor definition.

text.zh: 将长度和测得时延统一为米与秒。
text.en: Express length and measured delay in meters and seconds.

text.zh: 代入距离除以时间，先求实际传播速度。
text.en: Substitute distance divided by time to compute the propagation speed first.

text.zh: 再除以真空光速，速度因子没有单位。
text.en: Divide by vacuum light speed to obtain a dimensionless factor.

prompt.zh: 不论将 $V_g$ 设为何种频率，测得同轴电缆输入电压 $V_{in}$ 的幅值均为 $1\mathrm{V}$。这根电缆的特性阻抗 $Z_0$ 是多少？
prompt.en: You measure the amplitude of the voltage at the input to the coaxial cable $V_{in}$ to be $1\mathrm{V}$ for any frequency you set for $V_g$. What is the characteristic impedance $Z_0$ of the cable?

text.zh: 先写反射系数与输入阻抗原式，识别随频率变化的驻波来源。
text.en: Begin with the reflection and input-impedance equations to identify frequency-dependent standing-wave behavior.

text.zh: 扫频改变 βL；若有明显负载失配，输入阻抗通常随频率改变，源端分压也会改变。
text.en: Sweeping frequency changes βL. With load mismatch, input impedance and hence the source divider generally vary with frequency.

text.zh: 按题设固定源和低损耗近似，输入幅度不随扫频变化，采用官方的匹配推断 ΓL≈0。
text.en: For the stated fixed-source, low-loss model, follow the official inference that constant input amplitude indicates ΓL≈0.

text.zh: 负载是 50 Ω，所以推断出的特性阻抗也是约 50 Ω。
text.en: The 50 Ω load therefore implies approximately the same characteristic impedance.

prompt.zh: 若发生器的频率为 $f=100\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$，计算同轴电缆上电压波的波长 $\lambda$。
prompt.en: Calculate the wavelength $\lambda$ of the voltage wave on the coaxial cable if the frequency of the generator is $f=100\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$.

text.zh: 先写公式表的波长与波速关系。
text.en: Begin with the crib wavelength–speed relation.

text.zh: 使用 a) 从时延测出的未舍入波速，并把频率换成 Hz。
text.en: Use the unrounded speed measured in a) and convert frequency to Hz.

text.zh: 代入数值，s⁻¹ 与 m/s 中的时间单位约去。
text.en: Substitute the values and cancel the time units.

text.zh: 按题目要求保留至少两位有效数字。
text.en: Retain at least the two significant digits requested.

prompt.zh: 计算同轴电缆的单位长度电感 $l$ 和单位长度电容 $c$。
prompt.en: Calculate the per-unit-inductance $l$ and per-unit-capacitance $c$ of the coaxial cable.

text.zh: 先写需要联立的两条原表公式；低损耗近似下使用无损线的 Z₀ 与波速关系。
text.en: Begin with both crib equations, using the lossless relations for Z₀ and speed in the low-loss approximation.

text.zh: 将 Z₀ 除以 u，根号相乘后只剩 l；将 Z₀ 乘 u 得到 1/c。
text.en: Divide Z₀ by u to isolate l; multiply Z₀ by u to obtain 1/c.

text.zh: 先代入求每单位长度电感，保留 H/m 单位。
text.en: Substitute to obtain inductance per unit length, retaining H/m.

text.zh: 再独立代入求电容，不要把分母中的 Z₀ 漏掉。
text.en: Substitute separately for capacitance, retaining Z₀ in the denominator.

text.zh: 把 H、F 分别换为 nH、pF；此处沿用未舍入时延，原解的微小差别来自中间舍入。
text.en: Convert H and F to nH and pF. The small difference from the official inductance comes from its intermediate rounding.

note.zh: 使用未舍入的 392 ns 得 l=196.0 nH/m；官方先取 vf=0.85 得 196.1 nH/m，属于舍入差异。
note.en: Using the unrounded 392 ns gives l=196.0 nH/m. The official 196.1 nH/m uses vf rounded to 0.85.

prompt.zh: 若测得负载电压幅值为 $V(L=100\mathrm{m})=0.904\mathrm{V}$，输入电压幅值为 $V(L=0\mathrm{m})=1\mathrm{V}$，求衰减系数 $\alpha$。
prompt.en: If you measure the amplitude of the voltage at the load to be $V(L=100\mathrm{m})=0.904\mathrm{V}$ and the amplitude of the voltage at the input to be $V(L=0\mathrm{m})=1\mathrm{V}$, determine the attenuation coefficient $\alpha$.

text.zh: 先写有损行波包络。负载匹配时幅度之比直接给出单程指数衰减。
text.en: Begin with the lossy-wave envelope; with a matched load, the amplitude ratio gives one-way exponential attenuation.

text.zh: 把两个测得幅度及线长代入，先形成无量纲比值。
text.en: Substitute the measured amplitudes and length, forming a dimensionless ratio first.

text.zh: 两边取自然对数；指数的负号不能省去。
text.en: Take natural logarithms on both sides, keeping the minus sign.

text.zh: 再除以负的长度系数，得到正衰减常数。
text.en: Divide by the negative length coefficient to obtain a positive attenuation constant.

text.zh: 幅度的指数衰减用 Np/m 表示，不是功率衰减或 dB/m。
text.en: This amplitude attenuation is in Np/m, rather than a power coefficient or dB/m.

prompt.zh: 计算同轴电缆的单位长度电阻 $r$。
prompt.en: Calculate the per-unit-length resistance $r$ of the coaxial cable.

text.zh: 先写原表低损耗衰减公式。按该题模型忽略并联漏电导 g。
text.en: Begin with the crib low-loss attenuation equation, neglecting shunt conductance g in this model.

text.zh: 两边乘 2Z₀，先解出未知串联电阻密度。
text.en: Multiply both sides by 2Z₀ to isolate series resistance per length.

text.zh: 代入未舍入的衰减系数和 b) 的 50 Ω 特性阻抗。
text.en: Insert the unrounded attenuation and the 50 Ω characteristic impedance from b).

text.zh: 化简并检查单位是 Ω/m。
text.en: Simplify and check the units are Ω/m.

concept.zh: 本题是从实验读数反推传输线参数：传播、匹配和衰减需要依次联系起来。
concept.en: This problem works backward from measurements to the propagation, matching and loss parameters of a transmission line.

known.zh: 电缆长 $100\,\mathrm m$，测得延迟 $392\,\mathrm{ns}$；图中 $R_g=25\,\Omega$、$R_L=50\,\Omega$，输入电压幅值不随频率变化。后续给出频率及输入、输出幅值。
known.en: The cable is $100\,\mathrm m$ long with measured delay $392\,\mathrm{ns}$. The circuit has $R_g=25\,\Omega$ and $R_L=50\,\Omega$, and the input-voltage magnitude is independent of frequency. Later parts supply frequency and endpoint amplitudes.

goal.zh: 求速度因子、$Z_0$、波长、单位长度电感与电容，再由幅值衰减求 $\alpha$ 和单位长度电阻。
goal.en: Find velocity factor, $Z_0$, wavelength and distributed inductance and capacitance; then infer $\alpha$ and resistance per unit length from attenuation.

approach.zh: 先由长度和延迟确定波速，再利用频率无关的输入测量判断匹配。最后处理损耗，注意电压幅值的衰减指数与功率的衰减指数不同。
approach.en: Find speed from length and delay, then interpret the frequency-independent input measurement to identify matching. Handle loss afterward, keeping voltage-amplitude attenuation distinct from power attenuation.

statement.zh: 一根特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$、时间延迟为 $T_d=50\mathrm{ps}$ 的传输线，连接在电压为 $V_g=10\mathrm{V}$、源阻抗为 $R_g=30\Omega$ 的发生器电路与负载阻抗 $Z_L=150\Omega$ 之间，如下图所示。开关在 $t=0$ 闭合，向传输线施加直流电压。
statement.en: A transmission line of characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$ and time delay $T_d=50\mathrm{ps}$ is connected between a generator circuit with voltage $V_g=10\mathrm{V}$ and generator impedance $R_g=30\Omega$, and a load impedance $Z_L=150\Omega$, as shown below. The switch closes at time $t=0$ and provides a DC voltage to the transmission line.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh:
计算下列量：
• 负载端反射系数 $\Gamma_L$
• 发生器端反射系数 $\Gamma_g$
prompt.en:
Calculate the following quantities:
• The reflection coefficient at the load $\Gamma_L$
• The reflection coefficient at the generator $\Gamma_g$

text.zh: 先写原表的端点电压反射系数；负载端和源端都以同一个线路 Z₀ 为参考。
text.en: Begin with the crib endpoint voltage reflection coefficient, referencing both ends to the same line Z₀.

text.zh: 负载端代入 150 Ω 和 50 Ω，先算差再算和。
text.en: At the load insert 150 Ω and 50 Ω, evaluating the difference and sum separately.

text.zh: 源端返回波看到 30 Ω 源电阻，因此对应系数为负。
text.en: A wave returning to the source sees its 30 Ω resistance, giving a negative coefficient.

text.zh: 两系数均为电压比，无量纲；负号表示源端反射电压反相。
text.en: Both coefficients are dimensionless voltage ratios; the negative sign indicates voltage inversion at the source.

parts.label: b

prompt.en: Calculate numerical values for $V_1^+$, $V_1^-$, $V_2^+$ and $V_2^-$ in the bounce diagram below.

text.zh: 先写初始分压和反射递推式，再按传播顺序逐个计算。
text.en: Begin with the launch divider and reflection recurrence, then evaluate in propagation order.

text.zh: t=0 时把 10 V、30 Ω、50 Ω 代入，得到第一正向阶跃。
text.en: At t=0 substitute 10 V, 30 Ω and 50 Ω to obtain the first forward step.

text.zh: 50 ps 时到达负载，第一反向波乘负载反射系数 +0.5。
text.en: At 50 ps the wave reaches the load; multiply by +0.5 for the first backward wave.

text.zh: 100 ps 时反向波到源，再乘 −0.25，得到第二正向阶跃。
text.en: At 100 ps the return reaches the source; multiply by −0.25 for the second forward step.

text.zh: 150 ps 时第二正向阶跃到负载，再乘 +0.5；两次反射的负号不能丢失。
text.en: At 150 ps the second forward step reaches the load; multiply by +0.5, retaining its negative sign.

text.zh: 把四个行波幅度标在反弹图对应的四条轨迹上。
text.en: Label these four traveling-wave amplitudes on their four bounce trajectories.

steps.math: \begin{gathered}V_1^+=6.25\,\mathrm V,\quad V_1^-=3.125\,\mathrm V\\V_2^+=-0.78125\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=-0.390625\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

parts.answer: \begin{gathered}V_1^+=6.25\,\mathrm V,\quad V_1^-=3.125\,\mathrm V\\V_2^+=-0.78125\,\mathrm V,\quad V_2^-=-0.390625\,\mathrm V\end{gathered}

figureCaption.zh: 持续 DC 阶跃的反弹图：各行波按 50 ps 单程时延传播，端点电压需累加历史阶跃。
figureCaption.en: Bounce diagram of a sustained DC step with 50 ps transit time; endpoint voltages include previous steps.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 画出 $0\le t\le150\mathrm{ps}$ 内负载电压 $V(z=L)$ 随时间变化的曲线。标注电压幅值和关键时刻，例如电压波发生相关反射的时刻。
prompt.en: Sketch a plot of the voltage at the load $V(z=L)$ vs. time for $0\le t\le150\mathrm{ps}$. Label voltage amplitudes and critical times, such as when the voltage wave undergoes relevant reflections.

text.zh: 先写每次到达负载所增加的电压：入射阶跃与即时反射阶跃相加。
text.en: Begin with each load voltage increment: add the arriving step and its immediate reflected step.

text.zh: 第一行波传播时间为 50 ps，未到达前，负载处仍没有电压变化。
text.en: The first transit takes 50 ps, so the load voltage remains unchanged before that arrival.

text.zh: 50 ps 到达时代入 V₁⁺ 与 ΓL，求第一次阶跃后的平台值。
text.en: At 50 ps substitute V₁⁺ and ΓL to obtain the first plateau.

text.zh: 100 ps 的反射发生在源端；还需再传播 50 ps 才影响负载，所以中间平台保持不变。
text.en: The 100 ps reflection occurs at the source and needs another 50 ps to affect the load, so the intermediate plateau stays unchanged.

text.zh: 150 ps 第二次入射带来负的增量。源持续接通，所以新平台要在旧平台上累加。
text.en: The second arrival at 150 ps gives a negative increment. With the source still on, add it to the existing plateau.

text.zh: 将增量加到 9.375 V，按右连续理想阶跃标记端点。
text.en: Add the increment to 9.375 V and mark right-continuous ideal-step values.

figureCaption.zh: 负载电压在 50 ps 上升至 9.375 V，在 150 ps 降至 8.203125 V。
figureCaption.en: Load voltage rises to 9.375 V at 50 ps and falls to 8.203125 V at 150 ps.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线达到稳态后的电压 $V_{ss}$。
prompt.en: Calculate the voltage on the transmission line after it has reached steady state $V_{ss}$.

text.zh: 持续 DC 的最终稳态中，无损传输线等效为理想连接；用串联回路的电压定律开始推导。
text.en: At final sustained-DC steady state the lossless line is an ideal connection. Begin with the series-loop voltage law.

text.zh: 先求最终电流，再乘负载电阻。
text.en: Solve for final current, then multiply by the load resistance.

text.zh: 代入 10 V、30 Ω 和 150 Ω。
text.en: Substitute 10 V, 30 Ω and 150 Ω.

text.zh: 也可对反弹图求和：第一负载增量为 9.375 V，每次往返乘 ΓgΓL=−1/8。
text.en: Alternatively sum the bounce increments: the first is 9.375 V and each round trip multiplies it by ΓgΓL=−1/8.

text.zh: 级数求和与 DC 电路分压完全一致。
text.en: The geometric sum agrees with the DC circuit divider.

concept.zh: 本题考查持续直流阶跃在失配传输线上的反弹过程，以及暂态与稳态的区别。
concept.en: This problem distinguishes the transient reflections of a sustained DC step from the eventual steady state.

known.zh: $V_g=10\,\mathrm V$、$R_g=30\,\Omega$、$Z_0=50\,\Omega$、$R_L=150\,\Omega$，单程延迟 $T_d=50\,\mathrm{ps}$；开关闭合后电源持续接通。
known.en: The sustained source has $V_g=10\,\mathrm V$, $R_g=30\,\Omega$, $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ and $R_L=150\,\Omega$, with one-way delay $T_d=50\,\mathrm{ps}$.

goal.zh: 求两端反射系数和前几次行波，画出指定时间内的负载电压，再求稳态电压。
goal.en: Find both reflection coefficients and the first traveling waves, plot the specified load-voltage history, and find the steady-state voltage.

approach.zh: 先求初始发射波，再按到达端点的时刻逐次反射。负载电压是入射波与反射波的和；长时间结果还应与直流等效电路相符。
approach.en: Start with the launched wave and reflect it at each arrival time. Load voltage combines incident and reflected waves; the long-time limit should agree with the DC equivalent circuit.

topic.zh: 半波线 · 四分之一波线

statement.zh: 本题所有电路中，发生器电压频率均为 $f=200\mathrm{MHz}=200\times10^6\mathrm{Hz}$，所有同轴电缆的速度因子均为 $0.65$。每问都应给出带单位的数值答案。
statement.en: For all circuits in this problem, the frequency of the generator voltage is $f=200\mathrm{MHz}=200\times10^6\mathrm{Hz}$ and the velocity factor of all coaxial cables is $0.65$. In each part, provide a numerical answer with units.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh:
仅对第 a) 问：可以使用下列特性阻抗的同轴电缆卷：
• 电缆类型 #1：$Z_{01}=25\Omega$
• 电缆类型 #2：$Z_{02}=50\Omega$
• 电缆类型 #3：$Z_{03}=75\Omega$
对下列每个电路，指定能将发生器阻抗匹配到负载阻抗的电缆类型（即特性阻抗 $Z_0$）和长度 $L$。

电路 #1
prompt.en:
For part a) only: you have access to spools of coaxial cable with characteristic impedances:
• Cable type #1: $Z_{01}=25\Omega$
• Cable type #2: $Z_{02}=50\Omega$
• Cable type #3: $Z_{03}=75\Omega$
In each of the circuits below, specify the type of cable (which characteristic impedance $Z_0$) and length $L$ that match the generator impedance to the load impedance.

Circuit #1

text.zh: 此问两端都是 100 Ω，优先使用原表的半波阻抗重复性质。
text.en: Both terminations are 100 Ω, so start with the crib half-wave impedance-repeat property.

text.zh: 无论选 25、50 还是 75 Ω 电缆，半波线都将 100 Ω 负载重复为 100 Ω 输入，等于源电阻。
text.en: A half-wave line of 25, 50 or 75 Ω repeats the 100 Ω load as a 100 Ω input, matching the source.

text.zh: 先由速度因子和频率计算电缆内波长。
text.en: First calculate the cable wavelength from velocity factor and frequency.

text.zh: 取一个半波的正长度即可完成所需匹配。
text.en: One positive half-wavelength length gives the required match.

text.zh: 因此三种给定电缆都可使用，长度相同。
text.en: All three available cables therefore work with the same length.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

text.zh: 不同的纯电阻之间使用四分之一波长变换。先写原表阻抗反演式并设输入等于源电阻。
text.en: Use a quarter-wave transformer between unequal real resistances. Begin with impedance inversion and set the input equal to source resistance.

text.zh: 先解出待选电缆的特性阻抗，代入 50 Ω 与 12.5 Ω。
text.en: Solve for the cable characteristic impedance and substitute 50 Ω and 12.5 Ω.

text.zh: 三种给定电缆中，25 Ω 对应类型 #1。再由统一的速度因子求波长。
text.en: Among the available cables, 25 Ω is type #1. Next calculate wavelength using the common velocity factor.

text.zh: 取四分之一波长，并核对反演后确实为 50 Ω。
text.en: Choose a quarter wavelength and verify the transformed resistance is 50 Ω.

text.zh: 所需类型与长度如下。
text.en: The required cable and length are:

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

text.zh: 先把串联电阻与电容合并为负载阻抗，再用四分之一波长性质变换。
text.en: First combine the series resistor and capacitor as the load, then use the quarter-wave property.

text.zh: 由频率求角频率，并把 1 μF 写为 10⁻⁶ F。
text.en: Calculate angular frequency and express 1 μF as 10⁻⁶ F.

text.zh: 利用 1/j=−j 求电容阻抗，并与 50 Ω 相加。
text.en: Use 1/j=−j for the capacitor impedance and add the 50 Ω resistor.

text.zh: 代入原表反演式，再乘分母共轭数，显示虚部符号为何反转。
text.en: Substitute into the crib inversion and multiply by the denominator conjugate to show the imaginary-sign reversal.

text.zh: Xc² 远小于 50²，因此实部约为 50 Ω，虚部为小的正电抗。
text.en: Since Xc² is negligible relative to 50², the real part is approximately 50 Ω with a small positive reactance.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 下图电路中，开路电缆长度 $\ell$ 为多少时，会使电压波在 $z=A$ 处全反射？
prompt.en: In the circuit below, what length of open-circuited cable $\ell$ would lead to full reflection of the voltage wave at $z=A$?

text.zh: 先写原表的开路支节输入阻抗。要使有电阻负载的并联节点全反射，可把支节输入变成短路。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-stub impedance. To obtain total reflection at a shunt node with a resistive load contribution, make the stub input a short.

text.zh: 令支节输入阻抗为零，即 cot(βℓ)=0，选择最短正电长度 π/2。
text.en: Set the stub input to zero, requiring cot(βℓ)=0; choose the shortest positive electrical length π/2.

text.zh: 短路支节并联任何有限负载都会把节点 A 的总阻抗压为零。
text.en: A shorted shunt branch makes the total impedance at A zero for any finite parallel load.

text.zh: 将节点阻抗代入反射系数原式；电压反相，模为 1。
text.en: Substitute the node impedance into the reflection equation; voltage reverses sign and the magnitude is one.

text.zh: 由共同速度因子和频率求得 λ=0.975 m，再取四分之一波长。
text.en: The common velocity factor and frequency give λ=0.975 m; take one quarter of it.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

concept.zh: 本题通过不同电路考查传输线的阻抗变换、匹配和开路支节的滤波作用。
concept.en: These circuits test impedance transformation, matching and the filtering action of an open-circuit stub.

known.zh: 所有电路均有 $f=200\,\mathrm{MHz}$、速度因子 $0.65$；第 a) 问可选 $25\,\Omega$、$50\,\Omega$、$75\,\Omega$ 电缆，各电路的连接与终端见原图。
known.en: All circuits operate at $200\,\mathrm{MHz}$ with velocity factor $0.65$. Part a offers $25\,\Omega$, $50\,\Omega$ and $75\,\Omega$ cables; each diagram supplies its connections and terminations.

goal.zh: 选出匹配所需的电缆类型和实际长度，计算指定输入阻抗，并确定使主线发生全反射的支节长度。
goal.en: Select cable type and physical length for matching, calculate the specified input impedance, and choose a stub length that produces total reflection.

approach.zh: 先把电长度与米数联系起来，再识别半波、四分之一波等特殊长度。遇到并联支节时改用导纳，先判断接点实际呈现开路还是短路。
approach.en: Relate electrical length to physical length, then recognize half-wave and quarter-wave properties. For a parallel stub, use admittance and identify whether the junction effectively sees an open or a short.

title.zh: 利用 Smith 图的单支节匹配
title.en: Single-Stub Matching with a Smith Chart

statement.zh: 使用所附 Smith 图，通过单支节匹配法将馈线的特性阻抗 $Z_0$ 与负载阻抗 $Z_L$ 匹配。如下图所示，匹配电路包含一段连接负载、长度为 $d$ 的直通线，以及一段与直通线并联、长度为 $\ell$ 的开路支节。本题所有传输线均有 $Z_0=50\Omega$。
statement.en: Use the included Smith chart to match the feedline’s characteristic impedance $Z_0$ to the load impedance $Z_L$ via the single-stub matching method. As shown below, the matching circuit consists of a through-line of length $d$, which is connected to the load and an open-circuited stub of length $\ell$, connected in parallel with the through-line. $Z_0=50\Omega$ for all transmission lines in this problem.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.zh: 阻抗归一化与 Smith 图

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗 $z_L$，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance $z_L$ and plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化定义。这里 z 为无量纲负载阻抗，参考阻抗取该题馈线的 Z₀。
text.en: Begin with normalization. The load impedance z is dimensionless and referenced to the feedline Z₀.

text.zh: 把复负载的实部和虚部分别除以 Z₀，保留电抗的正号。
text.en: Divide the real and imaginary parts by Z₀ separately, preserving the positive reactance.

text.zh: 在 Smith 阻抗图中找 r=Re(zL) 圆与 x=Im(zL)>0 弧的交点；也可用反射系数验证坐标。
text.en: On the impedance chart intersect the r=Re(zL) circle with the positive-x reactance arc; verify the plotted coordinate with the reflection coefficient.

text.zh: 将已归一化的复数代入，得到该点的 Γ 平面坐标；它位于上半平面。
text.en: Substitute the normalized complex impedance to obtain its Γ-plane coordinate, in the upper half-plane.

prompt.zh: 确定并在 Smith 图上标出归一化负载导纳 $y_L$ 的位置，然后读出其数值。
prompt.en: Determine and plot the location of the normalized load admittance $y_L$ on the Smith chart, then read off its numerical value.

text.zh: 先写归一化导纳定义，再代入 Y=1/Z，说明为什么结果是 1/zL。
text.en: Begin with normalized admittance and substitute Y=1/Z to show why it equals 1/zL.

text.zh: 复数取倒数要乘共轭数；分母变成实部平方加虚部平方。
text.en: Take the complex reciprocal by multiplying by the conjugate; the denominator becomes the sum of squared components.

text.zh: 在同一阻抗网格上读取导纳时，表示坐标应关于图心反转，即旋转 180°。这不是让实际负载的反射改变符号。
text.en: Reading admittance on the same impedance grid requires reversing the displayed point through the center, a 180° rotation; the actual load reflection does not change sign.

text.zh: 因此沿同一个等模圆转到对径点，再读出电导与电纳；代数倒数与图上结果一致。
text.en: Move to the diametrically opposite point on the same magnitude circle and read conductance and susceptance; the algebraic reciprocal verifies the chart.

prompt.zh: 确定直通线的长度 $d$，使其输入导纳的实部与特性导纳 $Y_0=1/Z_0$ 匹配（即 $y_d=1+jA$）。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一长度的全部过程。答案可以用波长表示。
prompt.en: Determine the length of the through-line $d$ that yields an input admittance whose real part is matched to the characteristic admittance $Y_0=1/Z_0$ (i.e. $y_d=1+jA$). Show all work for how you determined this length on the Smith chart. You may leave your answer in terms of wavelengths.

text.zh: 先从原表输入阻抗式取倒数并归一化，得到向源移动距离 d 后的输入导纳。
text.en: Begin by taking the reciprocal of the crib input-impedance equation and normalizing to obtain admittance a distance d toward the source.

text.zh: 把负载导纳分成 g+jb，将分母写成实部 1−bt 与虚部 gt。
text.en: Write load admittance as g+jb and express the denominator with real part 1−bt and imaginary part gt.

text.zh: 乘分母共轭数，单独取实部。匹配实部要求实际输入电导等于 Y₀，即归一化实部等于 1。
text.en: Multiply by the denominator conjugate and take the real part. Matching conductance to Y₀ requires normalized real part one.

text.zh: 展开分母并把右边移到左边，得到可逐项代入的二次方程。
text.en: Expand the denominator and collect terms to obtain the quadratic for substitution.

text.zh: 把本题的 g、b 代入并求根；两个根对应 Smith 图与 g=1 圆的两个交点。
text.en: Substitute this load’s g and b and solve. The two roots correspond to the intersections with the g=1 circle on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 列出两个 t 值，再由 t=tan(2πd/λ) 选 0≤d<λ/2 的分支。
text.en: List both t values, then choose branches satisfying 0≤d<λ/2 using t=tan(2πd/λ).

text.zh: 反正切的负值要加 π 后再除以 2π；距离按 λ/2 周期重复。图上对应从负载向源顺时针旋转。
text.en: For a negative arctangent add π before dividing by 2π. Distances repeat modulo λ/2; on the chart rotate clockwise toward the source.

text.zh: 把两个距离对应的 t 代回输入导纳式，验证实部确为 1，并保留待抵消的虚部。
text.en: Substitute each t back into the admittance formula to verify real part one and retain the susceptance to be cancelled.

text.zh: 选第一组非负距离作为本页主答案；另一分支仍是有效匹配方案。
text.en: Choose the first nonnegative distance as the primary solution; the other branch is also valid.

note.zh: 核对：官方图给出 d≈0.271λ、ℓ≈0.305λ、b≈2.82，另一分支写 d≈0.318λ。直接代入给定 zL=0.5+j1.8 后，精确结果为本页数值；另一分支 d=0.378411λ、ℓ=0.192411λ。已用输入导纳方程独立校验。
note.en: Check: the official chart gives d≈0.271λ, ℓ≈0.305λ, b≈2.82 and an alternative d≈0.318λ. Direct substitution of zL=0.5+j1.8 gives the values here; the other exact branch is d=0.378411λ, ℓ=0.192411λ. Both are independently checked with the input-admittance equation.

figureCaption.zh: 按给定负载精确计算的导纳 Smith 图；两组匹配结果在推导中分别核验。
figureCaption.en: Admittance Smith chart computed from the stated load; both matching branches are checked in the derivation.

prompt.zh: 确定完成阻抗匹配所需的开路支节长度 $\ell$。在 Smith 图上展示确定这一长度的全部过程。答案可以用波长表示。
prompt.en: Determine the length of the open-circuited stub $\ell$ that completes the impedance match. Show all work for how you determined this length on the Smith chart. You may leave your answer in terms of wavelengths.

text.zh: 先写原表开路传输线阻抗，再取倒数并用 Y₀=1/Z₀ 归一化。
text.en: Begin with the crib open-line impedance, then invert and normalize with Y₀=1/Z₀.

text.zh: 支节并联时导纳相加，目标是总归一化导纳为 1。若主线为 1+jB，支节必须为 −jB。
text.en: Parallel admittances add and the target total is one. If the main line is 1+jB, the stub must supply −jB.

text.zh: 代入 c) 选中分支的电纳，列出需要满足的正切方程。
text.en: Insert the susceptance of the selected branch from c) and write the tangent equation.

text.zh: 选最小非负的开路支节长度；正切为负时使用第二象限的电长度。
text.en: Choose the smallest nonnegative open-stub length; a negative tangent requires a second-quadrant electrical length.

text.zh: 核对虚部恰好抵消；若改用另一主线交点，必须同时改用配套的支节长度。
text.en: Check exact susceptance cancellation. Choosing the other main-line intersection also requires its corresponding stub length.

text.zh: 本页所选分支的开路支节参数如下。
text.en: The open-stub parameters for the selected branch are:

concept.zh: 本题考查用 Smith 图完成单支节匹配，重点是并联时应使用导纳。
concept.en: This problem constructs a single-stub match on the Smith chart, using admittance for the parallel connection.

known.zh: 负载为 $Z_L=(25+j90)\,\Omega$，所有线段均有 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$，匹配支节开路。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(25+j90)\,\Omega$, all line sections have $Z_0=50\,\Omega$, and the matching stub is open-circuited.

goal.zh: 求归一化阻抗、导纳，以及直通线距离和开路支节长度，并标出 Smith 图上的读数过程。
goal.en: Find normalized impedance and admittance, then the through-line distance and open-stub length, showing the Smith-chart readings.

approach.zh: 归一化后先作阻抗到导纳的中心对称转换，再向发生器方向旋转到电导匹配处。此时支节只需补偿电纳，注意两条可行分支与读数方向。
approach.en: Normalize, reflect through the chart center to convert impedance to admittance, then rotate toward the generator to match conductance. The stub cancels susceptance; keep track of both branches and the direction of the wavelength scale.
